$comment: Reviewed Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon (add-privacy-preserving-analytics D4b: Cloudflare-hosted, SRI-pinned, until Cloudflare answers the self-hosting question, task 3.2). The build emits this exact integrity; browsers refuse any other bytes. Bump only after the review procedure in README.md. A weekly drift check (.github/workflows/beacon-drift.yml) compares the live file with this hash.
reviewedBy: Claude (agent, security-reviewer procedure); human security-reviewer sign-off pending (add-privacy-preserving-analytics 6.1)
reviewNotes: 2026.10.0 re-review (diffed against 2026.9.1, Wayback capture 20260903004426id_, byte-identical to the previous pin). Unchanged: no innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/document.write/eval/new Function/WebAssembly/string timers; no cookie, localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB or Cache access; no DOM element creation or setAttribute; no new fingerprinting APIs. Only network destination is still https://cloudflareinsights.com/cdn-cgi/rum (sendBeacon / XHR; send.to and forward.url overrides pre-exist, unused by us and blocked by connect-src). Payload fields identical apart from versions.js. location and referrer still pass through cleanLocation (query, fragment and userinfo stripped); history/navigation hooks still only when spa is not false; we set spa:false. Changes: webpack module wrapper replaced by a flat bundle; new guarded polyfills (Array.prototype.includes, globalThis, queueMicrotask) via Object.defineProperty, inert on modern browsers; the UA parser also reads the CriOS/FxiOS version and derives macOS/iOS version from navigator.userAgent (no new data source). Config precedence changed: a pre-existing window.__cfBeacon now overrides the data-cf-beacon attribute and is read live at send time. Nothing in our code sets __cfBeacon and the landing CSP allows no inline script, so no effect for us. Response still ACAO *, no cookie.
